content.short: Firefly is a Web3 social media aggregator.
content.description: Firefly is a Web3 social aggregator that pulls together content from Lens, Twitter, and Farcaster into a multidimensional timeline. Developed by Mask Network, it aims to redefine decentralized social networks by blending Web2 and Web3 functionality. Firefly delivers a heterogeneous social stream that merges on-chain and off-chain content, providing a unified experience across multiple networks and social protocols. By combining familiar social flows with blockchain-based signals, Firefly helps users navigate on-chain and off-chain content in a single cohesive feed.
